verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an email marketing platform with a REST API, but the evidence shows no per-contact engagement or activity endpoint. The API documents campaign-level reports and link clicks, plus webhooks for subscriber and campaign events. Neither shows that a developer can pull one contact's history of what was sent, opened and clicked, so these are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read per-person engagement history — what was sent, opened, clicked — through the API for any contact
